objective: Implement the next bounded offline phase of the microstructure V3 handoff: a fail-closed server-side exporter library with a zero-argument fixed-root CLI and focused tests. It may read one pre-provisioned validated Local EVIDENCE_DIAGNOSTIC task, one DIAGNOSTIC_READY Server Canonical V3 state, and its exact 14 retained day/envelope pairs, then create one immutable 30-file handoff package and validate it with the frozen shared contract. This task must not deploy, connect to a server, transfer data, run the analyzer, write canonical state, add a timer, or make a performance claim.

inputs.locator: Server V3 source release 20260806T162152Z remains the evidence source; current state is not assumed ready. Export must return NOT_READY without writing until an exact DIAGNOSTIC_READY 14/14 state exists; no server access is allowed in this task.

stop_conditions: Change exactly two new files and no others: research_pipeline/microstructure_handoff_export.py and research_pipeline/tests/test_microstructure_handoff_export.py. Preserve all existing bytes, including this task and the frozen handoff module and schemas.

Expose main(argv) as a zero-argument CLI. Any argument returns usage failure. Production paths must be constants for the V3 binding, V3 canonical state root, retained microstructure day root, pre-provisioned Local task file, private export staging root, and final export root; no environment or caller path selection.

Keep one internal RuntimePaths injection seam for offline tests only. The module must not discover other diagnostics, tasks, roots, versions, or work by scanning; every selected identity comes from the fixed binding and exact validated task.

The pre-provisioned task must pass the existing strict validator, be READ_ONLY EVIDENCE_DIAGNOSTIC, preserve all fixed prohibitions, have zero candidate variants and network NONE, and be hashed from its exact canonical UTF-8 bytes. Reject noncanonical, duplicate-key, linked, non-regular, or mutable task input.

Read only the binding, its exact canonical state file, and the exact 14 state-declared retained V3 bundle/envelope pairs. Require one DIAGNOSTIC_READY state with 14 contiguous days and a single bound source release. A non-ready state returns NOT_READY and creates no staging or final output.

Construct the frozen manifest deterministically from validated source bytes, exact task id/SHA, source release, state hash, ordered day hashes and chain, and the fixed discovery-only inference boundaries. Do not change the manifest or result contracts.

Create a private task-owned staging directory and the exact 30 files without following links, rewriting source, or overwriting any target. Force file and directory metadata where portable, validate the completed staging inventory with validate_handoff_package, then publish only by one exclusive atomic directory rename on the same filesystem.

If the final task directory already exists, validate its exact 30-file package and return IDEMPOTENT_IDENTICAL only when it binds the same task/state/manifest bytes. Any partial, extra, linked, altered, conflicting, stale staging, cross-filesystem, or rename race state fails closed without cleanup or overwrite.

The exporter may create only beneath its export staging/final roots and must never write the binding, canonical state, retained day roots, .research-state, database, server Research Worker state, or any Trading path. It must not start a subprocess, shell, network call, timer, analyzer, or transfer.

Focused tests must cover zero-argument CLI; fixed-path selection; valid 30-file creation; exact manifest values; NOT_READY no-write; invalid task; state/task/source/chain/hash drift; missing/extra/partial/link inputs; existing exact/conflicting package; stale staging; rename race; and cross-filesystem rejection through injected device ids.

If exact create-only publication cannot be implemented in two files without editing the frozen handoff contract, schemas, CLI router, docs, packaging, service units, installer, verifier, or any existing file, stop BLOCKED and report the exact missing proof. Do not broaden scope or weaken checks.

Run exact task validation, focused unittest for test_microstructure_handoff_export.py, Python compile checks for both new files, and git diff --check. Do not run Java, Maven, network, SSH, server, source, deployment, analyzer, evidence, candidate, OOS, or Trading actions.

Return one valid local-research-result JSON tied to this exact task SHA, exactly two files_changed/artifacts, all safety assertions false, concrete test counts, and MISSING_PROOF for live Linux metadata, deployed fixed roots, fixed task provisioning, transfer, Local runner, 14-day evidence, predictive value, fees, slippage, PnL, and drawdown.

Stop after offline exporter proof. Manager review and commit are separate; task provisioning, package/deploy/service wiring, live export, one-way transfer, Local analyzer runner, candidate registration, and OOS remain later bounded gates.
